lead: We design and fit out hotels, mini-hotels, aparthotels and country resorts: concept, room mix planning, lobby and reception, restaurant and leisure areas, hard-wearing materials and hotel-grade FF&E. General contracting from design to opening day.
about: A hotel is a business model in drawings

Every decision in a hotel affects revenue and running costs: how many rooms fit on a floor, how quickly housekeeping can turn a room, how durable the finishes are, how guest and staff flows are separated. So we start with the format and room mix, and only then with style.

We design standard rooms as a system: the same furniture, lighting, sanitaryware and textiles across the floor. This simplifies procurement, maintenance and replacement — and every guest gets the same quality.

Yablu Rest — a space for leisure, reception and conferences in a warm loft style, with a double-height hall, timber beams and a stove. Kitana Beach — concept and architecture of a beach complex in Bodrum, Turkey, with overwater cabins, pools and reception. Yacht Restaurant and Monpark — restaurants that can become the heart of a hotel.

We source furniture, lighting, textiles and tableware directly from factories in China through our Ozdoba catalogue. For hotels this works especially well: rooms are standardised, the minimum is 10 units per item and orders start from $500. Custom colours, sizes, materials and finishes are possible, and volume discounts apply to larger orders.

Delivery takes 30–60 days, so we order right after the specification is approved, in parallel with construction. Design costs from $30 per m² (minimum $2 500); renovation is priced per project. We invoice companies registered in Ukraine; EU invoicing is being set up.

faq: How much does hotel design cost?
Design from $30 per m², minimum project fee $2 500. Renovation is priced per project after a site survey and brief.
Do you work on mini-hotels and aparthotels?
Yes: mini-hotels, boutique hotels, aparthotels, rental apartments, resorts and country complexes.
Can you furnish rooms with FF&E from China?
Yes, through the Ozdoba catalogue: orders from $500, minimum 10 units per item, custom manufacturing available. Delivery takes 30–60 days.
Do you deliver up to opening day?
Yes. Design, renovation, FF&E, installation and styling by one team, one manager and photo reports every 1–2 weeks.
